interface.name: pd_window_position_manager_v1

description.summary: where the compositor placed a client's windows

interface.description: Wayland keeps window positions with the compositor. AppKit reports frames in screen coordinates, so a window learns where it is from this.

event.name: usable_area

description.summary: the part of the screen windows may cover

event.description: The first screen less the exclusive zones of panels such as the menu bar and the dock, in global compositor coordinates. Sent on bind and whenever it changes.

interface.name: pd_window_position_v1
interface.description: Sent once when created and again every time the compositor moves the window.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: where the client wants its window

request.description: Top left in global compositor coordinates. Wayland leaves placement to the compositor, an AppKit window still opens and moves where the app put it.

request.name: set_level

description.summary: the window level AppKit gave the window

request.description: A CGWindowLevel value. A modal panel (8) or floating panel (3) stays above the other windows of its client, and a click on one of those windows goes to the modal panel.

request.name: activate

description.summary: bring the window forward and give it the keyboard

request.description: Sent when the user asked for the app from outside it, such as a click on its Dock tile. The window manager decides, as it does for a click on the window.

description.summary: top left of the window in global compositor coordinates
